door-cell-bars.note: REJECTED: panel came out nearly square twice (width:height 0.91, re-mesh 0.88; catalog 0.56). At the 60x108 box the width would be squeezed to 0.63 of the height's scale (1.6x uneven), over the kit's 1.5x. One re-roll used (re-mesh). A new plate with the TALL, NARROW sentence would probably cure it.

door-cell-bars-open.note: LEFT OUT, not a bad mesh: its closed twin door-cell-bars was rejected, and an open twin cannot ship alone. The mesh itself passes (77x27 at 108 tall, same design as the closed one, Gemini 1.0). Flip this and re-plate the closed one to get the pair.
